sourceCopy.name: Spider Solitaire
sourceCopy.title: Spider Solitaire Online Free | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Play Spider Solitaire in 1, 2 or 4 suits with undo, hints and fresh deals. Free in your browser, no account or download.
sourceCopy.intro: Build descending sequences in the same card suit from King to Ace, reveal face-down cards and complete all eight sequences. Choose one, two or four card suits.
sourceCopy.summary: Play Spider Solitaire with one, two or four card suits, legal sequence moves, stock cards, automatic sequence removal, undo, hints and fresh shuffled games.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do you play Spider Solitaire?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Move face-up descending sequences of the same card suit onto the next higher rank or an empty column. Reveal hidden cards, draw ten cards from the stock pile when every column is occupied, and complete eight same-suit King-to-Ace sequences to win.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Does Spider Solitaire save my game?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The game runs in this tab and does not save a game, use an account, upload moves or send them to a server. Starting a new deal replaces the current game.

additionalFaqs.question: What is the difference between one, two and four card suits?
additionalFaqs.answer: One card suit is the most relaxed mode, two card suits add another suit, and four card suits require matching the suit across a mixed-suit tableau.

additionalFaqs.question: When can I draw cards from the stock pile?
additionalFaqs.answer: Draw ten cards, one to each column, while stock remains. Every tableau column must contain at least one card before drawing from the stock pile.

additionalFaqs.question: How does undo work?
additionalFaqs.answer: Undo restores the exact previous game state for a move, stock deal or completed-run removal. Up to 100 recent actions are kept only in this tab.
